verdict.rationale: Parahelp's docs say you can prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how your Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short. Automations can watch your tools and support queue and surface gaps on their own, and the agent analyzes hundreds of resolved tickets to propose baseline configurations. missing for 10: detail on what the reports and suggestions actually contain or how they are presented, insights over business data beyond support tickets and agent performance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
